sceneConcept: A tired twenty-six-year-old Chinese AGV night dispatcher stands alone against a transparent background. Her black hair is tied in a high ponytail, and dark circles remain visible beneath alert brown eyes. Wearing an unmarked orange dispatch jacket over a black hoodie and dark cargo pants, she holds a plain walkie-talkie near her mouth and listens through a compact earpiece while looking sharply to the side, under soft even frontal light without workstation screens or written notes.
